mentions.name: HeyLife
mentions.description: An iOS app that sends early notifications telling the user what to actually prepare or do before upcoming events, such as pinging the night before a trip with a packing list based on the destination's weather, or reminding the user to book a table for a planned dinner.
mentions.problem: The author has ADHD and describes a calendar full of things that were fine right up until they were on fire, i.e. events becoming urgent without advance preparation.
mentions.audience: The author builds it for his own needs, describing his personal ADHD-related calendar struggles.
mentions.source_excerpt: So about to release an iOS app that sends me early notifications about what to actually prepare, or do.

evidence.value: So about to release an iOS app that sends me early notifications about what to actually prepare, or do.

mentions.name: heylife.ai
mentions.description: A proactive AI agent that reads the user's calendar and gives pertinent advice on what to do next — for example suggesting what to pack when a flight is two weeks away, the best way to get to the city upon arrival, or a heads-up to buy a gift or book a restaurant for a parent's birthday. Currently enrolling testers via TestFlight.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a proactive AI agents that read your calendar and give you pertinent advices on what you should do. For example you have a flight in 2 weeks, tell you what to pack. When you arrive , tells you the best way to get to the city.

You have your mum's birthday, give you a heads up on buying a gift or booking a restaurant.

I'm now enrolling people on testflight: https://heylife.ai
